_comment: AFL roster corrections + Sportsbet name matching. Applied at roster LOAD (roster.py _apply_afl_name_overrides) AND at GENERATION (generate_afl_roster.py), so the daily 04:30 Draftguru scrape can't undo them. Sections: (1) overrides = CONFIRMED roster->Sportsbet renames (roster key renamed + both spellings resolve to the Sportsbet name); use ONLY when the Sportsbet spelling is confirmed from a live 'Available: player=...' reject line. (2) aliases = candidate alternate Sportsbet spellings TRIED against the LIVE catalog at placement (main._afl_canonical_catalog_player) -- whichever spelling Sportsbet's board actually carries is used, in ONE lookup, NO extra POST / no double-stake retry. SAFE to list an unconfirmed variant here: an exact-normalised catalog match resolves to the intended player or nothing (never a different player), so listing BOTH spellings just lets the live board decide. First-name diminutives already covered by _AFL_FIRST_NAME_GROUPS in main.py (Matt/Matthew, Mitch/Mitchell, Ollie/Oliver, Nic/Nick, Lachie/Lachlan, Cam/Cameron, Dan/Daniel, Sam/Samuel, Josh/Joshua, Tom/Thomas, Charlie/Charles, Will/William, Ben/Benjamin, Zac/Zak/Zachary) do NOT need an alias -- these are the NON-diminutive spellings/suffixes. (3) team_overrides = force a player's club (fixes a same-name scrape collision, e.g. two Max Kings). (4) add = insert a missing player. (5) remove = drop a retired/delisted player the scrape still lists. Keys/values match what the roster/tip uses vs what Sportsbet lists.
